english: This place looks more decent than that last town.
Does anyone recognize this scenery?\nI don't.
Did Noel come here...?
She might be around.\nLet's search!
I wonder if [MERU] came here?\nI wonder...\nGeez, always making me worry!
Hmm... dramatically speaking, being separated\nmight work for the film, but...
But still, I hope\nthey make up soon...
Is there a map somewhere... ah, shall we\nlook for a police box?
That sounds good.\nI'll search along the road!
No need for that!
Oh, someone we know?\nThen we're safe!
Wait, Haruka! That person is-!!
Hey!
It's you!!
Wah!! The twintailed phantom thief!?
Where did you pop out from!?
Riko!?
We caught up!!
Howdy, Mikawaya at your service~☆
Riko!!\nYou came here to get holes blown in you!?
As if.\nI'm a good girl, y'know?
Quit the lame puns\nand give me one good reason\nnot to shoot you, frog girl (Froggy)!
On my great-grandpappy's name, take your best shot?\nLime girl (Limey)!
W-wait, please!
Move! You'll get holes in you too!
B-but, Riko came here\nto talk about something, didn't she...?\nThen let's talk it out properly!
Weell,\nsomeone here has sense.\nBig-chested girls really do have big hearts!
Shut up, ugly! I'll turn you into Swiss cheese!
Now now, Aria.\nAnd you - if you're serious about talking,\nstop provoking Aria.
I only came\nto talk from the start.\nAnd of course, it's super-valuable intel!
Like I can trust you! It's obviously a trap!
No idiot would take this risk\njust to set a trap.
She's got a point. So what do you want\nwith us, your enemies?
Glad you asked!\nSo...
Wanna pull a heist with me?
Wh-what!?
Don't screw with me!! Eat this!!
Wah! W-wah! N-n-n-nooo!
That's right -\nshoot a righteous thief and YOU\nbecome the villain. Kufufu!
I'd appreciate it if you'd talk\na little more straight with us?
Yep.\nUp ahead there's a place called IS Academy.\nOh - do you know what IS is?
Eye-ess?
Infinite Stratos.\nTake the initials: IS.\nLike super-strong powered suits.
Could that be-!?
The black unit\nTsubasa held off?
Schwarzer Regen!\n(I nearly bit my tongue!)
The one that eyepatch girl was wearing!\nLaura's, I think...!
If you know the Schwarzer Regen,\nthis'll go fast.
IS Academy has\ntons of those things, y'see.
Now I understand your plan.\nYou're trying to get your hands on an IS, aren't you?
Ding ding ding! Correct!\nAs your reward, I grant you the right\nto pull a heist with me!
What right!? I'll throw that right back at you -\nwith bullets attached!
No good, Aria's no good at all!\nYou have no idea\nhow dangerous IS are.
The IS that made Tsubasa choose to sing the Superb Song...!
And there are tons of those...
Exactly.\nIS are super-dangerous weapons\nbuilt for world domination.
IS Academy is a military base disguised as a school.\nI'm gonna have you infiltrate it. So?\nWanna take me up on it?
No way!\nGo by yourself!
Um, you don't have to refuse so quickly...
It's all lies!\nIt's obviously all made up!\nBelieve her and you'll regret it!
Believe it or not, that's up to you.\nBut I was super-elite in the Detective\nDepartment (Inquesta), y'know?
Watch yourselves. There are 467 IS units\nin this world, and most of them\nare at IS Academy.
Dawdle and you'll die, okay? Kufufu!
Ah! Wait a sec!
Aria, shouldn't we chase her?
So you're letting her off the leash for a while.
Yeah. Riko always does what she says she'll do.\nSo let's use her.
So Riko plans to infiltrate\nIS Academy?
What'll we do?
This doesn't look like it'll end quietly!
We can't judge\nwithout accurate intel.\nWe need to learn what IS actually are.
We're going to IS Academy.
Isn't charging straight in dangerous...?
If Riko says she's going, something will happen\nat IS Academy. Seeing it ourselves is\nthe most reliable intel.
I agree.\nEven if we learned about IS as this world's common knowledge,\nwe couldn't judge if it's true.
I think we should go to IS Academy too!\nI'm worried about Riko.
Worried about HER!? What are you saying!?
But we have to catch Riko and go back,\nright?
Mmph... ugh, whatever! What a pain!\nSo annoying!!
//Fade to black\n//Background: IS Academy arena\n//Houki and Cecilia are having a mock battle.
*Hah... hah...*
Look more delighted. Being granted the honor\nof facing ME, England's representative candidate -\nisn't that glorious?
//Event CG: Houki, one-sidedly beaten in the mock battle with Cecilia. Equipped with Uchigane.
To think the gap in our strength is this great...!\nBut...!!
Now, dance!\nTo the waltz played by me, Cecilia Alcott,\nand Blue Tears!
Don't mock me!! Hah!!
//Event CG off
Two minutes, seven seconds. You lasted well.\nI'll praise you for it.
Still, against a training unit like the Uchigane,\nit's not even a warm-up.
Blue Tears is the cutting-edge third-generation IS,\nand with ME piloting it, there's no one\nwho could possibly match-
//SE: Alarm sound\n//Red emergency lights flashing, if possible.
What!?
Observation room, is anyone there! Tell me\nthe situation- wha, comms cut!?\nWhat's happening!!
//Fade to black\n//Background: IS Academy
Security override, complete.\nI've done my homework, y'know.\nNow then...!
//Background: IS Academy arena\n//SE: Barrier deactivating
The arena's barrier is gone!?
What's going on!? I don't understand\nthe situation at all!
//Background: IS Academy exterior\n//Aria and the others are there\n//SE: Alarm sound
The alarm is ringing!?
It's Riko! No doubt about it!
Wah! What do we do...!?
We've got no choice but to go, right?
Ugh... into a place full of IS!?
When in doubt, charge ahead!! Right!!
You all stay here.\nI'm going!
Aria!?
I'm going too!
Aoi!
Yes - to the Twin Angel...!
I kinda thought it'd come to this, but...\nEveryone, let's go!
//Battle map: IS Academy arena\n//Cecilia and Houki deployed as third force
Observation room! Respond!
If this kind of trouble had happened during\nour mock battle, it would've been terrible...
//Enemy grunts appear
What are those!?
Targets for marksmanship training?
//Enemy grunts move and attack Houki
Wh-!? What are you doing!?
Shinonono, stand back! I don't know if it's\na system malfunction or what, but I'll subdue\nthem with Blue Tears!
Like hell - I can fight too!
//Third force: Cecilia attacks and defeats the grunts\n//Riko appears
Hmm, impressive.
You're unarmed... it's dangerous here!
Nice! Blue Tears!\nIt's pretty AND cool!\nI want it even more now!
Whoever you are,\nno one but me can handle\nthis Blue Tears!
Won't know till I try.\nSo - hand it over!
I refuse!
You're the one controlling these weird things!?
Who knows?
It's you!! But I won't be beaten\nby the likes of these!
Right? But don't worry -\nsome stooong allies are coming soon!
//Deploy allies
There! Riko! This is as far as you go!
Yoohoo! I've been waiting, everyone~!\nGotta have friends, right!
Friends, my foot! You-!!
Okay! Everyone!\nCapture that IS!\nWell, that's that! Byebyee!
Huh!? What are you talking about!?
//Riko vanishes.
She vanished!?
I see... so you're her allies!\nYou ruffians! I'll punish you!
Wait, please! We're not\nsuspicious people-
You look suspicious however I look at it!
Who're you calling suspicious!?
You're wearing the same clothes\nas that girl from before!
Ah.
Aw~, we got played...
//Riko reappears and adds more grunts
Yes yes! Here's a bonus!\nEveryone, hang in there!\nBlue Tears, getto da ze!
//Riko vanishes
Don't screw with me! Riiikooo!!
So you ARE her allies!!
Trespassing at IS Academy is a grave crime!\nPrepare yourselves!
Eek!! What do we do!?
Geez, can't be helped!\nShould we do it? Should we?
We can't do that!\nWe have to prove we're not enemies...
Let's take care of\neverything Riko left behind!\nThen let's talk again!
That's our only option.\nEveryone, don't touch those two!\nTake out everything else!
//Victory condition: wipe out all grunts\n//Battle start\n//Battle ends when condition is met
We did it!
Um! Excuse me!
What!? We're in battle!
W-wait, please!
Wh-!? You're... wide open!?
(Quite literally fearless...)
We have no intention of resisting.\nAs you can see, all the enemies are defeated.\nNow we can talk calmly.
Enemies?
What we just beat were OUR enemies!\nWe'd like to talk with you first.
If you wish to negotiate,\nI demand you disarm!
Fine, we'll comply.\nSo please hear us out.
//Battle end\n//Background: IS Academy arena
I haven't the faintest idea\nwhat you're talking about!
I'm telling you, we came to this world to catch\nthat Riko from before - how many times\ndo I have to say it!!
What idiot would believe such nonsense!\nWhere did you come from, how?\nProve it!
I wish we could prove it, but\nthat's proving rather difficult...
I can't trust a single word!
This is troubling...
Hmm, how do we get them to believe us?
U-um! We\nknow about IS!
Um... black, Shubar#%&*, Regen...\nauu! It's so haaard...!
Shuba-whatever-Regen? ...There are only 467 IS\nin the world, so one check and your lie\nwill be exposed!
It was the Schwarzer Regen. Black, piloted by\na girl with an eyepatch. We encountered and fought\nit in a world different from this one.
That's impossible.
Either way,\nIS Academy will decide your fate.\nWe'll be taking you into custody.
That's only natural.\nWe want to know about IS too,\nso I guess that's fine?
...Huh?\nYou want me to ask that...?\nWhat do I do... f-fine. I'll ask, okay...
Um, just one thing...
What is it?
Who came up with that outfit?
Wh-!?
D-don't look!! Don't look at me\nwith those pervert eyes!!
//SE: Houki strikes Claude
Gehah!?
//Claude down
Why would you say that NOW...
Huh!? You said it on purpose to get punched!?\nWhat an advanced technique...!
//Fade to black\n//Background: IS Academy exterior\n//Riko muttering about her failure
I thought they'd wear each other down a bit more.\nShould I have egged them on more~?
Well, whatever.
//END
